retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast punk rock aesthetic featuring a sticker-covered acoustic guitar paired with heavily distressed, stencil-like typography on a solid black field.

recipe.visualDefinition: A horizontal composition centered on a grayscale acoustic guitar body covered in punk-style stickers and decals. Large, white, distressed block lettering dominates the upper half, while a secondary red subtitle sits tucked under the main title. The entire scene is set against a stark, void-like black background, emphasizing the gritty textures of the instrument and the raw edges of the type.
coreVisualRelationships: The guitar neck acts as a horizontal baseline for the secondary red text.
The large white title overlaps the upper curve of the guitar body.
The red circular 'splatter' graphic inside the letter 'A' mirrors the red circular sticker on the guitar's lower bout.
High-contrast grayscale instrument textures against flat, saturated red and white graphic elements.
coreInvariants: Limited palette of White, Red, and Grayscale

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The guitar is positioned horizontally in the lower two-thirds; the main title occupies the top third, spanning the full width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white 'THE ALARM' text serves as the primary anchor due to its scale and brightness.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large white text, drop to the red subtitle, and follow the guitar neck from left to right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of solid black negative space surrounding the central cluster of elements to create a 'floating' effect.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast between the black background and white elements; high saturation red for emphasis.

letterConstructionRules: Irregular, eroded edges suggesting woodblock or stencil wear
Inconsistent vertical alignment to create a 'DIY' feel
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'A' contains a red circular splatter or poppy-like graphic in the counter space.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Size and color contrast; large white eroded display type paired with smaller red condensed sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Sticker-bombing (collage of small icons/text on the guitar)

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and blocky structure.
Matches the DIY, military-adjacent punk aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grayscale acoustic guitar horizontally oriented on a solid black background. The guitar body should be covered in a dense collage of punk-style stickers, decals, and hand-drawn markings. Ensure high contrast with bright white highlights on the guitar strings and edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, white, distressed block lettering across the top. Add a secondary line of smaller, bold red text positioned above the guitar neck on the right side. Incorporate a red splatter graphic inside the counter of one of the large letters.

verificationChecks: Is the guitar grayscale and sticker-bombed?
Is the main text white and heavily distressed?
Is the subtitle red and positioned above the neck?

adjustableVariables: Density of stickers on the guitar
Level of erosion on the typography
Placement of the red accent graphic
mustRedesign: Specific sticker logos (replace with generic punk icons)
Specific band names in the text
postGenerationChecks: Check that the red text is clearly legible against the black.
Ensure the guitar texture doesn't look like a standard photo but a graphic illustration.
Verify the 'A' splatter doesn't obscure the letterform entirely.
Confirm the horizontal balance between the guitar body and neck.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Grayscale Object with Sticker Collage] + [Large Distressed White Display Type] + [Small Red Accent Type] + [Solid Black Background] to create a [Punk Rock] aesthetic.
